effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Mamemon] in its text and 1 card with the [Mutant] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
